newsitem.title: USA: Cooper Cameron oks shr buyback for co plans.
newsitem.headline: Cooper Cameron oks shr buyback for co plans.

text.p: Cooper Cameron Corp said Tuesday its board had approved the repurchase of the company's common stock in the open market from time to time.
Cooper Cameron said in a release that the repurchased shares will be used in various company employee stock ownership, option and benefit plans.

Vice President of Investor Relations Scott Amann told Reuters there is no time limit for the repurchase program, although the maximum amount of shares to be repurchased in the open market is 2.5 million.
However, Amann said, there is "no overwhelming need to buy the shares in today's market."
He said the repurchase program is expected to continue from time to time in the future.
